query: SELECT player_character.character_id AS "character_id!: i64" FROM action JOIN speech_message ON speech_message.speech_action_id = action.id JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = speech_message.message_id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id JOIN player_character ON player_character.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id WHERE action.requesting_tool_execution_id = ?
